messages:
Kelsey M.: Quick sync — finished transcript and quote pulls from StonyBrook pilot. Need legal OK on one line and then social + launch calendar slot.

Raj P.: awesome, can you paste the quote?

Kelsey M.: "Their latency dropped 3x and infra cost by ~42% — we can now hit realtime pricing tiers." — wants to use on website + banner.

Mariana C.: hmm that percent looks strong. Do we have a signed consent form for the numbers and the customer name?

Kelsey M.: yes, we have the signed case consent PDF in Drive (link: https://redwood.app/drive/stonybrook-consent). Uploaded to the asset tracker too.

Ben S.: tagging legal-bot for a quick scan @legal-bot :eyes:

legal-bot: Automated check: Consent form present. Flagging one potential compliance note: the phrase "realtime pricing tiers" may imply SLA changes. Recommend rewording to "real-time inference at production cost targets" unless legal confirms.

Paul H.: sales asked to keep the percent in the one-pager; it helps conversion. Can legal do a quick approval?

legal-bot: Human review required. @Mariana C. / @Kelsey M. please confirm no regulated data mentioned.

Kelsey M.: No PHI/PII. This was a performance & cost study only.

Mariana C.: OK I'm fine to proceed pending legal signoff. Also we should run A/B copy: one with percent, one with relative phrasing. I put two options below: 
Option A (headline): "StonyBrook reduces inference cost by 42% and cuts latency 3x using Redwood."
Option B (headline): "StonyBrook achieves 3x faster inference and significantly lower inference costs with Redwood."

Raj P.: Option B sounds safer. Less numeric claim.

Ben S.: Sales prefers A. Can we keep A on paid ads and B on organic?

Kelsey M.: Good plan. For the launch calendar: aiming for Tuesday the 14th (two weeks out) for blog + hero banner, webinar w/ StonyBrook on Thursday the 16th. Does that conflict with Q2 benchmarks release?

Mariana C.: Benchmarks team has a publish on Monday the 13th. Tuesday is fine. Webinar on Thurs is tight for scheduling speakers but doable.

Paul H.: I'll handle commercial routing — need to add a lead tag: "stonybrook-case" and ensure demo request auto-forward to Paul + Raj.

Raj P.: I'll add a route in the inbound rules: tag=customer_case_stonybrook, notify=@Paul H., cc=@Ben S. Also set priority=high for MQLs in the first 72 hours.

Kelsey M.: Copy for social + banner below — pls quick edits.
```
Short tweet: "StonyBrook cut inference latency 3x and reduced costs by 42% with Redwood Inference. Read the case study: https://redwood.com/stonybrook"
LinkedIn hero: "How StonyBrook scaled real-time features while lowering inference spend — case study out now."
```

Mariana C.: change tweet to remove raw percent until legal confirms: "StonyBrook cut inference latency 3x and reduced costs significantly with Redwood Inference."

legal-bot: Reminder: once legal provides approval, add approved_quote_id=SB-2026-04-17 to metadata.

Kelsey M.: Great — @legal-bot / @legal-team can you confirm approval by end of day tomorrow? We need to finalize creative and book the webinar panelists.

legal-bot: Noted. Escalating to Legal reviewer. ETA 18 hours.

Ben S.: Meanwhile I'll ping StonyBrook to confirm speaker availability for Thurs 16th.

Paul H.: Also confirm 30-min webinar format, 20-min case + 10-min Q&A. If we get big registration numbers we can do 45 mins.

Mariana C.: When legal signs, I'll create the launch Trello card, attach assets, and schedule the social posts.

Kelsey M.: Thanks all — please react with :thumbsup: when you complete your action items. I'll update this thread with the legal OK and final copy.

Raj P.: :thumbsup:

Mariana C.: :thumbsup:

Ben S.: :thumbsup:

Paul H.: :thumbsup:
